source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: As the Declare Battle Formations step begins, this unit may join another unit of yours that a **CRYPTEK** model is leading; each unit can take at most one CRYPTOTHRALLS unit. If it joins, its models are treated as belonging to that Bodyguard unit for the rest of the battle, and the Starting Strength of that Bodyguard unit goes up by the same number.

detail.when: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

join.recipient: one other friendly unit being led by a CRYPTEK model
